name: nonApi_canTestRunsPage
description: Internal (no auth of its own). May this portal user test / import a kennel's runs page (the kennel editor's Test button)? Called by the API's RunsPageTest (api/Endpoints/RunsPageImport.cs) AFTER it has validated the portal token with HC6.ValidatePortalAuth bound to the kennel; this SP is only the permission: HC6.CheckKennelPermission 'createEditRuns' on that kennel (a runs page writes runs), hare scope 0. Resolves the kennel from its PUBLIC id (deleted = 0).

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: The kennel, by public id. Unknown or deleted -> KennelId NULL, Allowed 0.

columns.name: KennelId
columns.description: The kennel's INTERNAL id, lowercase text; NULL when the public id resolved nothing.

columns.name: Allowed
columns.description: 1 when the user holds createEditRuns on the kennel, else 0.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.ErrorLog (HcVersion '<api>') then THROW on any runtime error.
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
